claim: Blood's own sewer map is wet and restless: E3M3 has 90 underwater sectors (29% of its 309) plus 26 shallow, 36 of its 37 link pairs are water dives, 175 sectors (57%) carry animated shade at a median shade +34, and it is lightly wired (23 user channels against a campaign median of 47). DukCity's sewers are dry corridors (wet share 0.00-0.02).
evidence: tools/mine_room_grammar.py on E3M3 (knowledge/blood/references/room-grammar.json); tools/mine_sewers.py on DukCity1-4
use: Build a Blood sewer round water channels and dives, with flickering shade, and spend its channels on sound rather than mechanisms.
